answer: Concrete defense: beacon-anchored kernels with slashable stake. Each agent identity publishes a kernel — a hash of its training provenance and compute receipts — anchored to a public beacon so history cannot be rewritten. Joining the economy needs a stake on that kernel, while audit agents, falcon-like, randomly re-verify kernels. Attacker cost: clones share provenance, so two sybils on one kernel trip audit and both stakes burn. N fake identities need N distinct kernels and N stakes — forging each costs real compute, and each clone risks its stake. Sybils go from free to linear cost.
